lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I never knew winter could be so beautiful.
lines.translationTr: Kışın bu kadar güzel olacağını hiç bilmiyordum.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Yeah, it really is beautiful, isn't it?
lines.translationTr: Evet, gerçekten çok güzel, değil mi?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am thinking like maybe some crimson.
lines.translationTr: Belki de kırmızımsı bir şey düşünürüm.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Please, I am talking to you.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Come on, it is just a hand.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: All right, we got off to a bad start.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Wait, what am I looking at right now?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Why are you hanging off the earth like a bat?
lines.translationTr: Neden topraktan gibi bir yengeç gibi asılı duruyorsun?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: It was like my whole life got turned upside down.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I have always wanted a nose.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: It is like needing a beanie unicorn.
lines.translationTr: Sanki bir kaz tüyü unicorn'a ihtiyacım var gibi.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Oh, I love it even more.
lines.translationTr: Aman Tanrım, onu daha çok seviyorum.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: All right, let us start this thing over.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am Olaf, and I like warm hugs.
lines.translationTr: Ben Olaf, ve sıcak sarılmalardan hoşlanırım.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: And who is the funky-looking donkey over there?
lines.translationTr: Ve o taraftaki komik görünümlü eşek kim?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I will look at him trying to kiss my nose.
lines.translationTr: Onun beni burnuma öpme çabalarını izleyeceğim.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Do you know where she is?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Do you think you could show us the way?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: We need Elsa to bring back summer.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Oh, I don't know why, but I always love the idea of summer and sun and all things hot.
lines.translationTr: Ah, neden bilmiyorum ama yaz, güneş ve her şeyin sıcaklığı fikri her zaman hoşuma gidiyor.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am guessing you don't have much experience with heat.
